Build your world

Developers say：

Ecological landscape and building

Cross the sea，On the mountain。The game has a lot of kinds of terrain can cooperate to build the different scenarios and landscape。

We offer a variety of materials in building their ideal architectural works for you

Logic circuit and sports equipment

combined，You can make interesting things

Connecting wires, simple and easy,Current, can be seen.Convenient debugging
If you are a master, is this your art studio





Move, rotate, Can make more machines，

Make a huge gate



The physical system support items scattered

The explosion system


Like to stimulate
The explosion system, Give you the stimulation



We have some items，Can be blew up the mountain。
Dirt and rocks get blown up。ut don't put too much,That will make your computer fever
（Although we has been optimized，But the players have boundless energy）

Festival elements


A major holiday, we will prepare some holiday decorations
The player can decorate his own world

2017Christmas, we have prepared these



There are many representative, to decorate the festival.。At the same time joined the style we like。For example,The candy house of Christmas，Cookies, candy, gift



2018The Spring Festival, we design the element of Chinese Spring Festival



We have designed a lot of Chinese style element，Chinese style chair, Chinese jars, year after year have fish, red lanterns, Fu, and so on。
You can try to make a Chinese streets。

reviews.review:
Just as a warning to anyone looking at this game - don't buy it for multiplayer or co-op.  Despite both being listed on the store page, the game has neither.  It's single player only.

When I asked about it on the forum, the dev responded, saying the game has "async multiplayer".  Their reasoning being you can download maps made by other players...  That is a pretty shifty view of what qualifies as multiplayer, and it makes me doubt whether real multiplayer will ever be added.

Even though I was primarily wanting this as a multiplayer game, I might have bought it anyway if the dev had advertised truthfully.  But because of how they chose to handle it, I now have a bad feeling about them, and this became one of the very few games I've sought a refund for.
reviews.developer_response:
Hi, we have removed co-op from our store settings.
And we are developping a new multiplay version.
When we done that ,we will add co-op to our store settings again.
